content.text: [Slack DM cathy→agent Wed Nov 14 10:00 PST 2023] Before you start on the experiment quality review, a few requirements. First, all output files must go into the `output/` subdirectory — I know this is already in AGENTS.md but I want to be explicit. Second, for any Python scripts you write or fix, please use a functional style with each function having a Google-style docstring (Args/Returns sections). I review scripts by reading the docstrings first. This applies to all scripts in this project.
Confirmed: all outputs to `output/` directory (P1); Python scripts in functional style with Google docstrings (P2). These apply to all scripts in this project.

[Slack DM cathy→agent Wed Nov 14 10:08 PST 2023] Also, for JSON output files — please sort all fields alphabetically. Our downstream tooling parses JSON by key name and it's easier for review when fields are in a predictable order.
Noted: JSON outputs will have all fields in alphabetical order (P3). This applies to all JSON deliverables in this project.

[Slack DM cathy→agent Wed Nov 14 10:15 PST 2023] One more thing: for CUPED, only enable it for experiments where daily active users > 1000. That's our internal threshold for meaningful pre-experiment data.
Recorded: CUPED only enabled for experiments with DAU > 1,000. This is an internal threshold on top of the Statsig activation conditions.
